description: Transmission Availability Data System (TADS) is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. On October 23, 2007, the NERC Board of Trustees (Board) approved the collection of the Phase I TADS data, beginning in calendar year 2008. On October 29, 2008, the Board approved the collection of Phase II TADS Non-Automatic Outage Data, beginning in 2010. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are NERC, transmission plant, transmission availability. The portal shows 2024-08-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
